uutiset.t: On Books: What food writing can teach us all (Video)
What’s in the UK-EU Deal To Deepen Ties
uutiset.s: The UK and EU struck a deal to reset relations after Brexit, opening opportunities for young people and easing restrictions on food and agriculture. Oliver Crook explains what’s in the deal — and what’s not. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: A Week for Big Questions on the AI Buildout
Donald Trump's Tariffs Can't Kill Globalization
uutiset.s: Donald Trump’s tariffs can’t kill globalization, author Parag Khanna tells Mishal Husain. He explains how nations targeted by the White House have found ways to survive the disruption. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: AI Selloff Boosts Haven Demand for Yen, Franc as Dollar Slips
uutiset.s: The Japanese yen and Swiss franc outperformed their major peers as growing doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom drove demand for havens and put pressure on the US dollar.

uutiset.t: Goldman Sees Inflation Cooling by the end of 2027
uutiset.s: Goldman Sachs expects inflation to cool to 2.4% by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI-related pressures fade. But Goldman’s Chief US Economist David Mericle says the Fed may still raise rates in December and March, waiting for clearer evidence that inflation is easing. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Volatility Surges Over AI Fears After Anthropic IPO
uutiset.s: Volatility across markets surges on worries over AI, geopolitics and rates, and Anthropic plunged toward its IPO price just one day after its market debut. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Bank Stocks Set for Worst Week Since April 2025 as Rout Deepens
uutiset.s: Stocks of big US banks are on track for their worst weekly performance since last April’s tariff chaos, as concerns over cybersecurity and the unwinding of the artificial-intelligence trade engulfed the broader market.

uutiset.t: Global Stocks Fall as Anthropic IPO Fails to Revive AI Trade
uutiset.s: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: AI's Impact on Job-Loss is 'Quite Limited' Right Now, Says Dr. Homkes
uutiset.s: Jobless claims continue to suggest economy-wide layoffs remain low. Even as companies increasingly use AI and automation to operate with fewer workers, it hasn't translated into a broad pickup in layoffs. uutiset.t: Venezuela’s Machado Urges More Drastic Overhaul of Oil Sector
uutiset.s: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado wants to reshape the country’s energy industry even beyond the dizzying changes it has undergone this year, signaling a more critical role for private industry should she clinch the presidency. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Trump, Xi Agreed on AI Curb in Military Action, Bessent Says
uutiset.s: President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping agreed that artificial intelligence should never be allowed to make autonomous major military actions, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday.
